label: Absence of a pure perfection at an unlimited root: three explanations and compiled E and L
summary: #2145 Investigation 1. Encoded the owner's three explanations of a pure perfection's absence at a root over one admissible profile family (TruthCore.Causality.RootPerfectionExclusion): exclusion by the admissibility constraints alone, by the positive profile (jointly; a single excluder is one case and pairwise compatibility does not suffice), or unexplained. absenceTrichotomy and absenceTrichotomyExclusive prove classical coverage and exclusivity relative to one family; the background (fixed family, positive nature as Has-profile, no extrinsic case at a root, purity outside the trichotomy) carries the content. The L bridge is derived in both limitation senses from joint compossibility plus the RootPurity bridge (structural) or a determination-to-esse bridge (formal); two root-reaching arguments compose E (no unexplained absence at actual roots) with L and the root's nonlimitation to conclude fe67d766, the second through rootUnlimited. Controls on one carrier show each open premise load-bearing: the joint-conflict row is a non-contracting exclusion model in this encoding and fails only joint compossibility among the L inputs; the standing-rival row fails only E; exact closure fails pure admissibility; an infinite all-pure profile fails root-profile admissibility. The A8 classifier route makes absence itself limiting (contraposed fullness) and is not a discriminating L. Under the exercise-or-potency reading, pure act and ab esse ad posse, own aptitude and exercise coincide at an own-being source, but productive and exemplary roles survive: the #1892 ImpersonalEminence source satisfies the collapse premises and violates only E; a personal source lacking an admissible pure determination violates E identically.
blocker: The derivation is conditional. Open: joint compossibility of pure determinations within the admissible family (positive rationale from DEF-PURE-PERFECTION, not a proof); E, no unexplained absence at actual roots (general rootless-determiner rationale; the rival's primitive closure is coherent and applies symmetrically); admissibility of noesis with simplicity (the articulation objection); admissibility of the root's actual profile; the determination-to-esse bridge; and purity of intellect itself, which the trichotomy does not classify.
